ache.title: Skin gacha math: he did it so you don’t have to
ache.note: This covers new gacha rates for grade 4 items and Ninetales skins, with Nero calculating the average spend to get one. When a skin needs an “average spend” calculation, it’s not a price; it’s a gamble with a range. Some players pay far above the average. That’s the part the math hides.
watch: a skin locked behind a gacha
rate changes that sound like good news
ache.tip: If you can’t see the price of a skin up front, don’t buy it. Clear prices are the only fair ones.
lines: a skin with odds isn’t a skin. it’s a bet
he did the math. the math said no

videoData.title: New Gacha Rates & Ninetales Legendary Skin | Pokémon Unite

textData.text: Hey everyone! In today's video, we'll dive into the latest updates on gacha rates, including changes that affect your chances of getting grade 4 items. We'll also discuss the new Ninetales skins in Pokémon Unite, including their costs and visual effects. I share my calculations on the average spend you might expect and explore whether the skins are worth it. Plus, I'll offer my personal opinions on the design and effects of these new skins. Don't forget to share your thoughts about the skins and the new gacha in the comments below!
